description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeDao class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically handling data access operations related to Employee entities. It includes methods for retrieving employee lists, counts, employee details, and hierarchy relationships, as well as saving and deleting employee records.

classes.name: EmployeeDao
classes.description: Data access object class responsible for Employee entity operations, including fetching lists, counts, hierarchy relations, and CRUD operations.

methods.name: getEmployeeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Employee entities based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmpNumbersByFilterParams
methods.description: Fetches employee numbers matching specific filter criteria.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeListQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs and returns a QueryBuilderWrapper for querying Employee entities with applied filters and sorting.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Persists an Employee entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an Employee entity by its employee number.

methods.name: getExistingEmpNumbers
methods.description: Checks which employee numbers from a given list already exist in the database.

methods.name: getSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId
methods.description: Recursively finds subordinate employee IDs under a specific supervisor.

methods.name: getNumberOfEmployees
methods.description: Gets the total number of employees, optionally including terminated ones.

methods.name: getSubordinateList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subordinate Employee entities for a supervisor, optionally including the chain of subordinates.

methods.name: isSupervisor
methods.description: Checks if a given employee is a supervisor (has subordinates).

methods.name: getReportingMethod
methods.description: Fetches reporting method details between subordinate and supervisor.

methods.name: getEmpNumberList
methods.description: Returns a list of employee numbers, optionally excluding terminated employees.

methods.name: deleteEmployees
methods.description: Deletes employees by their employee numbers.

methods.name: getSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId
methods.description: Recursively finds supervisor employee IDs for a given subordinate.

methods.name: getEmployeeWorkShift
methods.description: Retrieves the work shift information for an employee.

methods.name: getAvailableEmployeeListForWorkShift
methods.description: Fetches employees available for work shift assignment, i.e., those without assigned shifts.

methods.name: getEmailList
methods.description: Returns a list of email addresses for employees.

methods.name: isEmailAvailable
methods.description: Checks if an email address is already used by any employee.

methods.name: isUniqueEmployeeId
methods.description: Determines if an employee ID is unique across employees.
